_note: Seeded 2026-08-19 (routing follow-up, GH #1466 — E6 coverage warn). Positives: judgment calls about whether a .claude doc/skill/hook/script is rot or convention, how a relocation should be verified, whether a status mismatch is normal. Negatives drawn from neighboring territory: the grammar rules themselves (doc-standards), executing the actual cleanup (harness:repo-cleaner), plain git state hygiene (harness:clean-git), and a work-state report (harness:check-state).
